query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM whatsapp_pairing p JOIN whatsapp_linked_account a ON a.id=p.account_id WHERE p.id=$1 AND p.user_id=$2 AND p.state='connected' AND p.consumed_at IS NOT NULL AND a.id=$3 AND a.authorization_generation=$4 AND a.identity_jid=$5 AND a.state='connected') AS "completed!"
